file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.last_proposal:
Selection adds bed, room, department, patient class, patient service, and service area details.  
It contains events of a specific recorded type within a configurable occurrence window.  
Rows are filtered by configurable as-of and matching rules, and exclude several specified units.

file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.audience_text: This is a selection from STRING_SPLIT(@ServiceArea, ','): the value is one of the values '0', the service area in which this department is located unique; carrying the constant 1.
file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.last_proposal:
Each row contains a single value from a provided list of service-area entries.  
Some values represent a specific zero indicator in the list.  
Each row also carries a constant indicator with value one attached.

file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.audience_text: This is a selection from STRING_SPLIT(@Location, ','): the value is one of the values '0', the revenue location to which the department is linked unique; carrying the constant 1.
file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.last_proposal:
Each selection contains one element produced by splitting the provided location string by commas.
The element is either a placeholder representing no location or a recorded revenue-location identifier.
Each selected element also carries a constant indicator value of one.

file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.audience_text: Event type indicates the category assigned to the event record.
Indicates whether a recorded event was changed or deleted.
the instant when the event was supposed to have happened
file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.last_proposal:
This field records the instant when the event was supposed to have happened.  
Rows represent events of type six that fall within a configurable window and selection criteria.

file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.audience_text:
The event record holds the patient identifier at its effective time.  
A matching record exists in each of two separately defined selections.

This field contains the patient class for the hospital encounter.  
It records that class as the category abbreviation.
Department name abbreviation for the event's unit at its effective time.

file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.last_proposal:
This field contains the room name from the attached room record for each selected event.  
Inclusion requires a specific recorded type.

file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.audience_text: Bed name is the name from the bed record that matches on bed contact.
This field shows the patient service name at the event effective time.

This dataset carries the instant when the event record was actually deleted.  
If the event subtype indicates deletion, the instant is on or after a configurable window.
Timestamp that shows when the event record is actually created.

file::COOK_RPT_USP_CCHCS_ADT_MONTHLY_INP.last_proposal:
This field shows the service area name for the department associated with the event.  
The service area is the area in which the department is located.
